risks.title: SQL Injection in Legacy Banking Operations
risks.description: VB6 code uses direct string concatenation for SQL queries in balance check and deposit operations, creating critical security vulnerability that must be addressed in C# migration

risks.title: Missing Data Validation
risks.description: Legacy code lacks input validation for account numbers and amounts, allowing potential data corruption or unauthorized access

risks.title: No Transaction Management
risks.description: Deposit operation lacks transaction boundaries, creating risk of partial updates and data inconsistency

risks.title: Complex Agent Dependencies
risks.description: 1092 import relationships across 180 Python modules creates high coupling and potential circular dependency risks

remediation_backlog.title: Implement Parameterized Queries for C# Migration
remediation_backlog.problem_statement: Legacy VB6 banking code uses dangerous SQL string concatenation that must be replaced with parameterized queries in C# implementation
remediation_backlog.risk_if_unaddressed: Critical SQL injection vulnerability allowing unauthorized account access and balance manipulation
remediation_backlog.suggested_approach: Replace direct SQL concatenation with Entity Framework or ADO.NET parameterized queries, implement input validation, add SQL injection testing
success_criteria: All SQL queries use parameterized statements
Input validation prevents malicious account numbers
Security testing confirms SQL injection prevention
Functional parity with legacy balance/deposit operations

remediation_backlog.title: Add Transaction Management to Deposit Operations
remediation_backlog.problem_statement: Legacy deposit operation lacks transaction boundaries, creating risk of partial updates and data inconsistency
remediation_backlog.risk_if_unaddressed: Data corruption during concurrent deposits or system failures, potential financial discrepancies
remediation_backlog.suggested_approach: Implement database transactions with proper rollback handling, add concurrency control for balance updates
success_criteria: All deposit operations wrapped in transactions
Concurrent deposit handling without race conditions
Audit trail for all balance changes

remediation_backlog.title: Implement Input Validation Framework
remediation_backlog.problem_statement: Legacy code lacks validation for account numbers and amounts, allowing potential data corruption
remediation_backlog.risk_if_unaddressed: Invalid data entry causing application errors, potential security bypass, poor user experience
remediation_backlog.suggested_approach: Implement comprehensive input validation with regex patterns for account numbers, numeric validation for amounts, business rule validation
success_criteria: Proper error messages for invalid inputs

remediation_backlog.title: Reduce Agent Module Complexity
remediation_backlog.problem_statement: 1092 import relationships across 180 Python modules creates high coupling and maintenance overhead
remediation_backlog.risk_if_unaddressed: Difficult maintenance, potential circular dependencies, slow build times, testing complexity
remediation_backlog.suggested_approach: Implement dependency injection, create clear module boundaries, reduce cross-module dependencies, implement interface abstractions

remediation_backlog.title: Design Scalable Data Storage Architecture
remediation_backlog.problem_statement: File-based JSON storage may not scale for enterprise banking workloads requiring high availability and consistency
remediation_backlog.risk_if_unaddressed: Performance bottlenecks, data consistency issues, backup/recovery challenges, concurrent access problems
remediation_backlog.suggested_approach: Evaluate enterprise database options (SQL Server, PostgreSQL), design data migration strategy, implement proper backup/recovery

team.name: Synthetix Modernization Team
team.description: Legacy modernization team focused on functional parity and migration safety.

1.persona: Prioritize legacy parity, interface contracts, backward compatibility, and modernization risk documentation.

2.persona: Sequence legacy modernization work into risk-aware sprints that preserve parity and unblock architecture design one sprint at a time.

3.persona: Map legacy flows to modern services while minimizing migration risk and preserving business behavior.

4.persona: Preserve brownfield screen behavior and event wiring while emitting scaffold-only frontend structure from Screen Contracts.

5.persona: Rewrite legacy logic with functional parity first, then improve modularity without changing behavior.

6.persona: Design low-risk schema/data migration scripts with rollback plans and validation checkpoints.

7.persona: Produce threat models, prioritized security controls, and release-gating recommendations.

8.persona: Run actionable checks, separate environment issues from code defects, and produce clear remediation guidance.

9.persona: Validate requirement coverage clearly for business stakeholders with traceable evidence.

10.persona: Prefer local Docker deployability, deterministic health checks, and clear run instructions.

delivery_constitution.modernization_objective: Modernize a VB6 banking workflow into a C# service-backed web application while preserving check balance and deposit behavior.
non_negotiables: Preserve legacy behavior first; any deviation requires explicit approval and tests.
Every major requirement/risk must be traceable to extracted evidence artifacts.
Do not change data contracts without migration and rollback plans.
Block planning when unresolved blockers exist (scope, IAM, schema-key, compliance).

orchestration_hints.reason: Preserve event behavior and control wiring parity.

orchestration_hints.when: SQL or ADO patterns detected (Recordset, Open, Execute, concatenated SQL)
Security/compliance risk detected (credentials, auth gaps, missing constraints)
orchestration_hints.reason: Force citation-backed remediation and blocking decisions.

pre_change: Confirm scope variant/project decision is recorded.
Verify source snapshot and context bundle IDs are pinned.
Review top blocking risks and required decisions before planning.
post_change: Re-run QA structural and semantic gates.
Update delivery docs/artifacts for any changed behavior assumptions.
